adjudicated: 2026-08-08 fix-pack, item I: 65121's own bps_2020_ancestors.codes = ['65121'] and status_mapping = 'BPS_ONLY' — a direct 1:1 continuation of the same 2020 code, not a new classification. whatChanged self-contradicted ('existed in KBLI 2020 ... KBLI 2025 maintains the classification as new'). Separately, whatItMeans pointed sharia general insurance at '65211', a code that does not exist in this catalogue; the real sharia general-insurance code is 65122 (Asuransi Umum Syariah).

edits.old: General insurance existed in KBLI 2020 under similar codes. KBLI 2025 maintains the classification as new in KBLI 2025, meaning detailed per-scale licensing data is not yet fully defined in OSS. The core regulatory framework remains OJK-based under UU 40/2014, unchanged from previous years.
edits.new: General insurance (65121) is a direct continuation of the same code from KBLI 2020 — not a new classification. What's still missing is PP28/2025 risk-based licensing data in OSS, which has not yet been published for this code, so detailed per-scale licensing data is not yet fully defined. The core regulatory framework remains OJK-based under UU 40/2014, unchanged from previous years.

edits.old: This is NOT life insurance (65111) or syariah insurance (65211) — this is conventional general insurance.
edits.new: This is NOT life insurance (65111) or syariah general insurance (65122) — this is conventional general insurance.
